text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Phew...—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.
choice_data_list: Believe! That was a great run!!!
Believe! That was a great run!!!

text_block_list.text:
There was the distance extension from the 
1200m races she had decided to focus on, 
as well as the presence of Calstone Light 
O, but—

Believe achieved a magnificent result! The 
fruits of her training—have certainly paid 
off!
choice_data_list:
(In that case, let's keep this momentum 
going...!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to focus on my training for a 
while longer.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
We've got the solid foundation down, so... 
I'd like to move on to polishing it up.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"This time, we'll incorporate more menus 
focused on practical races, boosting 
muscle strength and explosive power—"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I want to hone my body for 1,200m races. 
Let's see... by summertime.

I nodded firmly back. There was no 
hesitation left. "We will do our job"— 
that resolve was set in stone.

There were still races available in 
spring, but there was no rush. Right then 
and there, they decided to set their 
sights on summer and beyond.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(...Build it up. Polish it. An unshakeable 
foundation by summer.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (And then—)

text_block_list.name: Takeo-san
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho, so your target race is set for the 
summer's Kitakyushu Kinen, huh. Fukuoka, 
eh? Better jump on booking those flights!

text_block_list.name: Kiyomi
text_block_list.text:
"You're right! I'd better dig my travel 
trunk out of the closet... And since it's 
midsummer, maybe I should get a new 
parasol too~."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Um. It's far, so getting there—

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, really, we're the ones who want 
to go!

text_block_list.name: Kiyomi
text_block_list.text:
That's right, wanting to cheer you on is 
our own choice. You don't need to worry 
about it, Believe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I'll give it my all. In the Kitakyushu 
Kinen.

A few days after the Falcon Stakes. I was 
out jogging in the usual residential area, 
partly to report the results.

"The residents are all genuinely overjoyed 
by Believe's victory... and they seem 
fully eager to keep cheering her on!"

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
By the way... hey there, you two. Once 
summer ends, the autumn season begins, 
right? And when you think of autumn—!

text_block_list.name: Takeo-san
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right on! Are you aiming for *that* 
race... the one that kicks off the autumn 
GⅠ season!?

Feeling everyone's expectant gazes on me, 
I look over toward Believe.

...A silent answer returns. Yes, both of 
our minds were made up.

Our immediate goal is the Kokura Kinen. 
Yet beyond that, the two of them look 
ahead to the ultimate autumn showdown at 
1200m—
choice_data_list:
Of course I'm aiming for it. The Sprinters 
Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Ladies & Gentlemen
text_block_list.text: "Ooooooohh...!!"

text_block_list.name: Takeo-san
text_block_list.text:
Oho~, things are really heating up!! 
Alright, let's keep the momentum going!

text_block_list.name: Takeo-san
text_block_list.text:
"Got some time to spare, you two? I got my 
hands on a bunch of early-season fava 
beans. Let's boil 'em in salt and have 
ourselves a feast!"

text_block_list.name: Kiyomi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the first harvest of the season! How 
wonderful~ They say it brings good luck, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Early-season produce...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, we still have time, so let's dig in

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Early-season broad beans, huh...

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so glad they liked it♪ Even 
so—we're finally aiming for a GⅠ in the 
autumn, aren't we!

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. You know, I thought 
Believe-chan's run in the Falcon Stakes 
was really, truly! Sooooo amazing, but—

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
The racing newspapers published after that 
praised me sooooo much! And on TV, too! 
Which means...!

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
"If we can win the Sprinters Stakes just 
like this, you know, THAT! Couldn't we aim 
for that!?"
choice_data_list: Huh? What do you mean by "that"...?

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
You know, that thing, umm... What was it 
called again, for New Year's... Right!

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text: The "URA Awards"!!

The URA Awards are honors presented by the 
URA, the organizing body of the Twinkle 
Series, to Umamusume who performed 
exceptionally well in the previous year.

The awards are divided into several 
categories, and are presented to the 
Umamusume who achieved the greatest 
accomplishments in each field.

And of course, winning a GⅠ is pretty much 
the single biggest factor in earning an 
award!

In that instant... the scene flashes 
vividly in my mind.

"Just like at the Holy Hoof Festival, 
seeing her—someone who usually hides in 
the shadows—basking in thunderous applause 
on a glamorous stage—!"
(Waaaaaahhh...!!)
choice_data_list: (I want to make this... a reality...!)

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
Right? It's totally possible, isn't it!? 
Because if she wins the Sprinters Stakes, 
she'll be the sprint queen of the Classic 
Class!
choice_data_list: Yes. I think there's definitely a chance!

text_block_list.text:
I answer firmly. At that moment, another 
goal took root within my heart.

Our first goal is the Kitakyushu Kinen. 
And our major target is the Sprinters 
Stakes. Furthermore—

Our aim is to win the URA Award! Let us 
ensure her accomplishments are fully 
honored!
